text: Voting Governance and Value Creation in Decentralized Autonomous Organizations (DAOs) should be assessed against Kaal's source-bound claim that Bitcoin and Ethereum are worth hundreds of billions of dollars not because people are using them but almost entirely because of speculation on their future value, which is the expectation that people will use them to build decentralized autonomous organizations. The current metadata indicates a plausible connection through decentralized autonomous organization, but the defensible response is a qualification until the source text confirms agreement, scope, methods, and limitations.
